summary: This topic outlines the process for applying fee concessions to students, including selecting predefined concession groups, setting concession amounts (percentage or fixed), and documenting the reason for the concession.
steps: During the fee collection process for a student, click on the 'Concession' button.
Select a predefined concession group from the available options (e.g., 'Sports Concession').
If the concession group is percentage-based, the system will automatically calculate the concession amount based on the fee structure.
If a 'Manual' concession is selected, enter the fixed concession amount.
Enter a mandatory remark explaining the reason for granting the concession.
Optionally, upload any supporting documents (e.g., a signed application from the principal) using the 'Choose File' option.
The student's payable amount will automatically update to reflect the applied concession.
business_rules: Concession groups (e.g., '50% criteria') must be set up in the system's master data.
Remarks are mandatory when applying a concession.
Concessions can be configured as a percentage of a fee head or a fixed amount.
important_notes: Concession data for existing (old) students needs to be imported into the system to ensure continuity.
The system can automatically calculate percentage-based concessions if defined in the master setup.
